name: software
description: Three focused skills for planning and committing software work: an 8-phase clean architecture vocabulary for classifying tasks (categorize-task), a planner that splits a master plan into per-phase plan files organized by feature track with complexity scores (split-plan), and an interactive Conventional Commits generator that groups your changes and writes the messages (conventional-commit). The orchestration half of this plugin moved to the guild plugin in v1.0.5.
